trigger.note: no round-level trigger pid. UntilLoseRespin (ST72) is a win-driven server-side FREE respin (CostCredits=0, ReMarks='Respin') that extends the triggering paid spin (ST1); it chains spin-after-spin until a losing respin ends the burst. ST72 wins carry a NATIVE PayoutIdToWinAmount on a normal PayoutByPayline (no synth needed). ReelSkin 11 is the wild-rich boost-reel state (1289/1422 of in-sample respins), pooled into the respin multiplier distribution.

validation.evidence: W1 (this onboard, 2026-06-18, chunk_0002 8 robots / 41,422 records): provenance clean (_cache_version:3, config af02d175 / code cd5158f7). 2 STs. ST1 = PAID base spin (CostCredits=1000, ReMarks='', full reel signature) -> paid_spin/Normal (strict-reuse generic per-ST plugins). ST72 = FREE respin (CostCredits=0 on 100%, ReMarks='Respin', full reel signature incl native PayoutIdToWinAmount) extending ST1 -> respin/UntilLoseRespin (play = server FeatureWin key); preceded by ST1 (410, the first respin) or ST72 (1012, chained) -> it EXTENDS a paid spin, the respin pattern. ECONOMY INVARIANT EXACT: per-ST sum(WinCredits) == server FeatureWin (Normal 28,609,000 == 28,609,000; UntilLoseRespin 8,585,000 == 8,585,000). ST72 field-signature-matches the validated respin STs (M43 ST50 WinRespin / M279 ST36 MoveSpin) -> STRICT-REUSE respin_dynamics via the generic respin ROLE hook (no new plugin, no machine_spec edit, no new frontend dimension). No novel mechanic: ST72 has 0 wins with no payid (1012/1012 wins carry a payid), no SymbolIndexToRewards / CollectCount / additive collect channel -> no _unattributed_residual, no ABORT.
caveats: ST72 respin-burst-length histogram (chain run-length len1/2/3...) + win-gating proof (which winning respins re-grant another respin) need per-round ReMarks / run-length accumulation in parser.py (base-closure) — respin_dynamics surfaces continuation_prob / uplift / grant-rate base-excluded and flags the histogram parser_blind (same boundary as M43/M279). Framework-team item.

ReelSkin-labeled boost-reel breakout (skin-1 vs skin-11 on ST72; skin 11 is the wild-rich state, 1289/1422 respins) is parser_blind — the plugin layer receives coarse per-ST RETURN_BUCKET histograms, not per-round ReelSkin. Its CONTRIBUTION is captured (pooled into ST72's multiplier distribution + the multiplier_profile fat tail). Framework-team item IF a labeled boost-reel metric is wanted. (Pattern note matches M279 skin-11: in-engine pure-random rare-boost state, fully testspin-observed, NOT out-of-engine.)

out_of_engine_mechanics.name: CurJackpotStoreWin progressive (test-interface-zeroed)
out_of_engine_mechanics.desc: Field 'CurJackpotStoreWin' is present on every ST1/ST72 round but =0 on 100% of in-sample records (41,422/41,422). FLEET-WIDE test-interface behavior (user-confirmed 2026-06-12, M275 gate 8): it IS a real progressive jackpot store, but the CURRENT testspin interface forces its accumulation to 0 (so the sample correctly shows 0). Parse as-is with the progressive contributing 0; the field is already in the ST1/ST72 signature, so parsing is FORWARD-COMPATIBLE — when the interface is later optimized to populate it, the existing parser picks it up unchanged. The data RTP is the BASE RTP (excludes the progressive); the progressive ADDS on top once enabled.
